stories.title: Latvia's Ruling Party Secures Election Victory Amid Rising Populism
stories.summary: In Latvia's recent parliamentary elections, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs' United List party secured a leading position with 35.4 percent of the vote, as reported with over 99.9 percent of votes counted. The election was characterized by a notable increase in support for populist parties, reflecting a shift in the political landscape.

stories.title: FlyDubai Co-Pilot Flagged for Extremism Concerns Before Incident
stories.summary: A FlyDubai co-pilot, who wielded an axe during a flight, had previously been flagged for extremism concerns. This incident has raised questions regarding the airline's employee vetting processes and how the co-pilot was allowed to operate a flight with Israeli passengers, given Israel's stringent security measures.

stories.title: Trump Calls for Action Against Senator Cotton Over Daylight Saving Bill
stories.summary: Trump has urged the public to contact Senator Tom Cotton of Arkansas, accusing him of obstructing a bill aimed at making daylight saving time permanent. In a controversial move, Trump also shared Cotton's cell phone number to encourage constituents to voice their concerns directly.
